rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — and glad the meetup talk landed. Halcyon Threshold is very early: right now it's just me, trying to figure out where a small amount of time and money is best spent. Live options on the table: a reading group, a tiny regranting effort, evals for something under-measured, or writing/curation. Given your background, here's something concrete that would genuinely help me decide: could you do a quick landscape scan of one area (say, independent AI safety evals projects, or small grant/regranting programs already out there) and summarize what exists and where the gaps are? That directly feeds into what I do next, and it's bounded enough to fit five hours. No rush, and happy to do a quick call first if that's easier than working from a cold brief. Thanks again for offering, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman: gave her a concrete bounded task (scan the evals / small-grants landscape)
